game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks, barracks half buried in snow: the firewood keeper must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against winter bandits.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks: barracks half buried in snow
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowdrift Barracks, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against winter bandits. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the spells value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the beacon fire using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The beacon fire reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the beacon fire is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Snowdrift Barracks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Snowdrift Barracks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The beacon fire reached with actions_used <= 19.
